attempted_claim: Do there exist any excluded minors for the class of 3-regular matroids (equivalently, Hydra-5-representable matroids) on 14 or 15 elements beyond the following 33 obstructions from Conjecture 1.3 of Brettell–Oxley–Semple–Whittle: F7, F7^-, F7^=, H7, M(K4)+e, W^3+e, Lambda_3, Q6+e, P6+e, U3,7 and their duals; the six matroids in Delta^*(U2,7); AG(2,3)\e, its dual and its Delta-Y variant; and P8, P8^-, P8^=, TQ8?
decisive_failure: No exhaustive H5 enumeration at n=14,15 was performed (no SageMath stack; candidate space >=1.7e8 GF(3527) splice checks by optimistic lower bound versus a multi-day published U2 batch job); no new fragile-structure theorems were proved; no candidate 34th obstruction was constructed or certified. The three artifact scripts are bounding/verification tooling only and establish no new matroid-theoretic fact. The existence question for residual 14/15-element excluded minors beyond the 33 remains fully open.
